signals.summary: Reported layoffs at the Wikimedia Foundation prompted editor strike and banner-sabotage plans.
Six Community Engineering staff were laid off after responsibility for the Community Wishlist moved.
The Wikimedia Foundation reported over $200 million in revenue for the 2025 financial year.
Nonprofit organization funded by donations from millions of individuals worldwide.
Staff union Wiki Workers United formed earlier this year; the foundation denies layoffs are connected.
